title: Training progress and an update note promise a phone notification every time
what: Before the owner sends 'Well done' or 'How's it going?', the line says it goes to the member's app with a notification on their phone. An update note says members now get a notification when a pause or renewal is approved. A notification only shows when the member allowed notifications, has a new enough app, and the gym has not already sent 2 pop-ups that day; the screen only admits the daily cap after sending.
expected: Say 'with a notification on their phone if notifications are on', like the Member messages page already does.
fix_line: Add 'if notifications are on' to the two lines

title: The owner cannot see which phones or computers get gym alerts with the admin app closed
what: Alerts with the admin app closed are turned on one device at a time, and Settings shows only the device in hand. The owner cannot see whether his own phone, the desk computer or any staff member's phone gets them. Complaints go to the owner only, so if none of his devices has alerts on, a complaint waits unseen until someone opens the admin app.
expected: Settings lists every device that has alerts on (whose, which device, last alert shown), and warns when the owner has none.
fix_line: Show a list of devices with alerts on, and warn when the owner has none

title: Gym alerts have no quiet hours, so a shop order can ring the owner at 2 am
what: Urgent alerts (shop orders, complaints, a friend asking to join, plan requests) always go at once, at any hour, and with 'Instantly' picked everything else does too. There is no night setting, so the only way to stop night alerts is the phone's own Do not disturb.
expected: A choice to hold alerts outside gym hours (for example 10 pm to 6 am) and send them together in the morning.
fix_line: Add quiet hours that hold alerts until the gym opens
